row.evidence: ServiceDesk Plus Cloud offers SAML on all three editions, but user provisioning goes through Zoho Directory or a vendor-run Microsoft Entra ID user sync that reads users via API; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: New in September 2026. ManageEngine is a suite; researched its flagship ServiceDesk Plus Cloud (ITSM), priced per technician (plus IT assets on Professional/Enterprise), with no charge for end users. SAML SSO is on all editions, including the free Standard tier (up to five technicians). No SCIM: provisioning is via Zoho Directory (two-way sync, can delete or disable users), a vendor-run Entra ID User Sync (1-7 day schedule; deleted users can have login revoked or be removed), or the deprecated AD Provisioning App. The Okta catalogue app is SAML/SWA only. Other ManageEngine products (ADSelfService Plus, Identity360) push SCIM out to other apps as identity tools; that is outbound and does not count here.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented for ServiceDesk Plus Cloud: the help-centre sitemap (761 pages) has no SCIM page, the v3 API reference has none, and the documented provisioning routes are Zoho Directory, the vendor-run Entra ID User Sync and the deprecated AD Provisioning App. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

audit_log_api.notes: An admin audit log exists in the UI (Setup > Data Administration > Audit Log); no API for it is documented.

user_api.notes: The public ServiceDesk Plus Cloud v3 API (Zoho OAuth 2.0) covers requests, problems, changes, projects, assets, CMDB and similar modules; its API index lists no user, technician, requester or role endpoints. Users are managed in Setup > Users & Permissions or through Zoho Directory.

okta.notes: OIN 'ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus' (last updated Jun. 21 2023) marks only SAML and SWA as checked (read from page markup); no SCIM or provisioning ticks. Vendor guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app.

entra.notes: Vendor-run Microsoft Entra ID User Sync reads users through the Graph API on a 1-7 day schedule; not SCIM. No Entra gallery tutorial found.

google.notes: Custom SAML app per vendor guide.
